## Proposal

A static gallery for `cs2-map-maker-maps` on GitHub Pages: one card per map showing the QA
contact sheet, name, centre, height scale, buildable %, relief, and a link to the folder.

- Generated by `publish` (#1) into `docs/index.html` (or a `gh-pages` branch) from the map
  folders' `manifest.json` files, so it never drifts from what is committed.
- Plain HTML + CSS, no build step; thumbnails are the QA sheets downscaled to ~600 px and
  committed alongside (`qa_thumb.jpg`) so the page loads fast.
- Sort by publish date, filter by buildable % and relief.

Depends on #1.
